info.title: Taskfolk API
info.description: Public REST API for Taskfolk (taskfolk.ai). All endpoints require a workspace-scoped bearer API key. Paths are nested under `/v1/workspaces/{slug}/…`.

bearerAuth.description: Workspace API key. Send as `Authorization: Bearer tfk_live_…`. Each key is bound to exactly one workspace and carries a set of scopes.

message.example: Label "foo" does not exist on this project.

scoped.description: True when access is restricted to explicit project members.

estimation_unit.description: How this project estimates work (POINTS-01): time (estimate_minutes), points (story_points), or none.

category.description: System category the status maps to (open/done semantics).

status_id.description: Specific board status id (project_statuses). See GET .../statuses.

status_name.description: Display name of the board status.

assignee_id.description: Primary assignee (compat). Equals assignees[0], or null when unassigned.

assignees.description: All assignee user ids, primary first. Set via PATCH assignee_ids.

story_points.description: Story points estimate (POINTS-01); used when the project's estimation_unit is "points". Null = unestimated.

relay_url.description: Same-origin fallback PUT path for networks that block the storage domain. PUT the same bytes here if the direct URL is unreachable.

released_at.description: Actual ship time; set when status becomes released.

data.description: Report-specific payload. Shape depends on `report`: velocity (bars + average), burndown (points), cycle-time (buckets + percentiles), throughput (weekly created vs resolved), status/type-breakdown (slices), workload (rows by assignee). Sprint-dependent reports may be null when the project has no sprints.

filter.description: Opaque filter blob (issueTypes[], priorities[], assigneeId, sort…).

user_id.description: ID of an existing workspace member.

role.description: New role for the member. Cannot promote to owner; use the ownership-transfer flow.

plaintext.description: Returned exactly once on create. Store it securely.

secret.description: Returned exactly once on create or rotation.

client_secret.description: Returned exactly once on create. Null for public (PKCE) clients.

is_public.description: Set true for PKCE public clients (no secret).

status_id.description: Board status id (project_statuses); wins over status.
Board status id (project_statuses); wins over status.

assignee.description: Primary assignee (user_id or email), or null to unassign. Back-compat single field; seeds a one-element assignee set.

assignee_ids.description: Full ordered assignee set (user_ids or emails), primary first. Wins over `assignee`; pass [] to unassign everyone.

sprint_id.description: Attach the issue to a sprint (sprint id), or null to detach. This is how issues are added to / removed from a sprint.

release_id.description: Attach the issue to a release (release id), or null to detach. This is how issues are added to / removed from a release.

category.description: System category the column maps to (drives open/done semantics).
System category the column maps to (drives open/done semantics).

status.description: Setting status=released stamps released_at; leaving it clears released_at.

target_key.description: Target issue KEY-NUM (e.g. WEB-12). Cross-project within the workspace is supported.

project.description: project key to scope the doc

r2_key.description: The exact r2_key returned by the intent call.

agent_id.description: The agent's user id — the value to pass as agent_id elsewhere and the id used when assigning issues to the agent.

kind.description: Provider: claude, openai, cursor, copilot, gemini, deepseek, kimi, perplexity, or custom.

owner_user_id.description: The human member who connected this agent.

cost_total.description: Total agent-reported cost across the agent's sessions (USD). Agent-reported; Taskfolk never runs the model.

key_revoked.description: Whether the agent's API key is revoked.

field_policy.description: FIELD-POLICY-01 allowlist of writable issue fields; null = all fields writable.

spend_cap_usd.description: Per-agent soft spend cap (USD), or null when unset. Alert-only.

external_url.description: Where the output lives — typically the PR URL.

cost_usd.description: Cumulative agent-reported cost of this session in USD (null if never reported). Agent-reported — Taskfolk does not run the model or verify spend.

tokens_in.description: Cumulative input tokens the agent reported.

tokens_out.description: Cumulative output tokens the agent reported.

model.description: The model of the latest usage report.

usage_reports.description: How many usage reports the agent has posted.

parent_id.description: The message this one replies to (may itself be a reply); null when top-level.

root_id.description: Thread root message id; null for a top-level message.

kind.description: Defaults to public. DMs cannot be created over the API.

parent_id.description: Reply to this message — the thread root or any reply within it (nested replies are supported).

share_url.description: Public /f/<token> URL; null unless public sharing is enabled.

project_id.description: Derived from a project-is condition; null = all projects.

assignee_user_id.description: The agent (isAgent user) or person for agent/person nodes; null otherwise.

config.description: Kind-specific config. condition: { match, rules } (AutomationConditions shape). agent: { title?, instructions? }. parallel: { join: "all"|"any" }.

branch_label.description: "true"|"false" on a condition node's out-edges; null otherwise.

node_id.description: Complete this active stage; omit to complete all active stages.

filter.description: Cross-project filter blob (projectIds[], statuses[], priorities[], types[], assigneeId, sort).

scope.description: Auto-KR work scope; null = inherit the goal's portfolio/workspace scope. Unknown ids are dropped.

weight.description: Relative weight in the goal roll-up (default 1).

scope.description: Auto KRs only; ignored for manual.

portfolio_id.description: null = company goal (not grouped under a portfolio).

status_override.description: Manual status override, or null when the status is fully derived.

status.description: Derived roll-up status (override applied). not_started = no measured progress yet.

progress_pct.description: Rolled-up 0-100, or null when nothing is measured.

scope.description: Auto-KR work scope; null = inherit the goal's portfolio/workspace scope. Unknown ids are dropped.

status.description: Derived roll-up status (override applied). not_started = no measured progress yet.

portfolio_id.description: Group under a portfolio, or omit/null for a company goal.

parent_goal_id.description: Alignment parent. Must stay acyclic and within the depth cap.

status_override.description: Set a manual status, or null to clear the override.
